name: vinglish-zero-launch-film
description: A three-minute Remotion launch film for Vinglish Zero.

scripts.render:4k: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts VinglishZeroLaunch out/vinglish-zero-launch-4k.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=15 --pixel-format=yuv420p --concurrency=6
scripts.render:presenter: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts VinglishZeroLaunch out/vinglish-zero-presenter-4k.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=15 --pixel-format=yuv420p --concurrency=6 --props='{"presenterSrc":"presenter.mp4"}'
scripts.render:preview: npm run assets && remotion render src/index.ts VinglishZeroLaunch out/vinglish-zero-preview.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18 --pixel-format=yuv420p --scale=0.5 --concurrency=6
scripts.still: npm run assets && remotion still src/index.ts VinglishZeroLaunch out/keyframe.png --frame=2250
scripts.assets: npm run render:manim && node scripts/generate-audio.mjs && bash scripts/generate-narration.sh
